reason: A staged document-processing workflow that parses EPUB/PDF books, supports OCR and agent-assisted reading, generates SKILL.md files, and installs them after human approval gates.

summaries.zh: 将 EPUB 或 PDF 书籍解析、阅读并转换为可安装的 SKILL.md 技能文件，流程包含 OCR、智能体辅助分析和人工审批。
summaries.en: Converts EPUB or PDF books into installable SKILL.md skill files through parsing, OCR, agent-assisted analysis, and human approval gates.

capabilities: Reads and parses local EPUB and PDF files
Can search and download books through an external z-lib service
Can use OCR services or loopback OCR endpoints for scanned PDFs
Runs agent-assisted reading, question generation, skill drafting, and self-checking
Stores resumable job state across sessions and restarts
Writes generated SKILL.md content to selected local skill directories after confirmation
Provides a browser timeline panel with human approval gates
